question.text: A client of Rs. 1 crore portfolio has AUM at Rs. 1.2 cr end-of-year. HWM = Rs. 1 cr. Hurdle rate = 10%. Performance fee = 20% above hurdle. Performance fee =

explanation.text: The Logic: Required at hurdle = 1 × 1.10 = Rs. 1.10 cr. Excess = 1.2 - 1.10 = Rs. 10 lakh. Performance fee = 20% × 10 lakh = Rs. 2 lakh. The Trap: Rs. 4 lakh = 20% of total profit Rs. 20 lakh (ignoring hurdle). Rs. 24 lakh = silly number. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-A Topic 10. Manager's Pro-Tip: Always clear hurdle BEFORE computing performance fee share.
